text_block_list.text: While out shopping, an Umamusume who looked like an academy student and a young girl caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that ribbon is so cute~♪
I'm gonna buy the same one as Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you☆
It's one of Curren's favorites too~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we search for it together? ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Not this one, not that either.
There's nothing at all, waah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Well... how about something like this?
Don't you think the frills are super cute?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~ I want the same one...
I wanna be pretty just like big sis...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Other ribbons look cute too♪
Hey, don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
See☆ Everyone has their own special charm,
and you have your very own unique
"cuteness" too♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh, my very own kind of cute...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right♪ Let's find your very own cuteness...
One that even Curren can't copy☆

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I get it...! So, so, what kind
should we go with!?
choice_data_list: Being full of energy is what matters!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Aha☆ That looks like it'll turn out super cute♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In that case, let's not just add a ribbon,
let's toss in some stylish glasses too! ☆

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I want glasses too!
'Cause I wanna be "cute"♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You've awakened to cuteness, haven't you☆
Let's get cuter and cuter♪

And so, the Umamusume set off for the novelty shop
in pursuit of total cuteness!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so cute♪
Like a refreshing light blue, or a happy yellow☆

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, what do I do...!
Now everything's starting to look "cute" to me~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Worry all you wantâ
You trying your hardest to be cute is super cute in itselfâª

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yay! I love you so much, Big Sis~~!!

The Umamusume took their sweet time shopping,
pondering their choices to their heart's content!
